title: ExerciseContentFile
description: Schema for content/exercises/<domain>/<exercise>.yaml. Enforced by apps/api/app/content/schema.py via `python -m app.content.validate`. Mirrored in TypeScript at packages/shared/src/content-types.ts.

business_context.description: Originally SQL-only; also used as the business-framing paragraph for BUSINESS_REASONING/DATA_INTERPRETATION case-study exercises (Phase 6).

sql_tables.description: SQL exercises only — tables to surface in the schema explorer; empty = all.

sql_solution_query.description: SQL exercises only — never sent to the client.

sql_hidden_tests.description: SQL exercises only — extra keyed-lookup checks against the student's own result.

python_datasets.description: PYTHON exercises only — dataset files to pre-load as DataFrames; empty = all files in `dataset`.

python_solution_code.description: PYTHON exercises only — never sent to the client.

python_result_variable.description: PYTHON exercises only — the variable name both student and solution code must define.

python_hidden_tests.description: PYTHON exercises only — Python snippets (typically assertions) run in the student's own kernel namespace after correctness passes.

dbt_model_name.description: DBT exercises only — the model name written to dbt/models/exercises/<name>.sql for real execution.

dbt_schema_yml.description: DBT exercises only — the columns/tests block nested under this model in a generated schema.yml; never sent to the client.

stakeholder.description: Case-study exercises (Phase 6) — a short job title framing who's asking.

constraints.description: Case-study exercises (Phase 6) — realistic limits on data/tools/time.

expected_deliverables.description: Case-study exercises (Phase 6) — what a complete answer should include.

rubric.description: Case-study exercises (Phase 6) — self-assessed evaluation criteria shown to the learner before they answer; see app/services/grading.py.
